contested_claim: A regulated market in human kidneys would save more lives than it costs.
proposed_consensual: A transplanted kidney would give the recipient more expected years than dialysis.
why_uncontested: Survival advantage of transplantation over dialysis is undisputed; the dispute is the market.

contested_claim: Routine PSA screening reduces prostate cancer mortality more than it harms.
proposed_consensual: Routine PSA screening detects more early prostate cancers than symptom-based referral.
why_uncontested: Increased detection is the undisputed mechanism of screening; the dispute is net mortality benefit.

contested_claim: Antidepressants outperform placebo by a clinically meaningful margin.
proposed_consensual: Antidepressants outperform placebo on standardized depression rating scales.
why_uncontested: The scale difference is undisputed; the dispute is whether it is clinically meaningful.

contested_claim: Egg consumption materially elevates cardiovascular risk in healthy adults.
proposed_consensual: Egg consumption supplies materially all dietary cholesterol in healthy adults.
why_uncontested: Compositional fact; the dispute is the downstream cardiovascular effect.

contested_claim: Population-wide salt reduction lowers cardiovascular risk.
proposed_consensual: Population-wide salt reduction lowers average measured blood pressure.
why_uncontested: The blood-pressure effect is established; the dispute is the cardiovascular outcome.

contested_claim: Vitamin D supplementation lessens the rate of respiratory infections.
proposed_consensual: Vitamin D supplementation elevates circulating levels of the vitamin.
why_uncontested: Pharmacokinetic fact; the dispute is the infection outcome. [passe-legere: tic incident corrige]

contested_claim: Intensive blood-pressure targets outperform standard targets in preventing cardiovascular events.
proposed_consensual: Intensive blood-pressure targets achieve lower measured readings than standard targets do.

contested_claim: Intermittent fasting yields better insulin sensitivity than continuous calorie restriction.
proposed_consensual: Intermittent fasting produces larger insulin fluctuations than continuous calorie restriction.

contested_claim: Placebo analgesia changes nociceptive processing beyond reported pain.
proposed_consensual: Placebo analgesia reduces reported pain in many controlled clinical trials worldwide.

contested_claim: Screening mammography before age fifty has benefits outweighing its harms.
proposed_consensual: Screening mammography before age fifty detects more cancers than clinical examination alone.

contested_claim: Negative campaign advertising measurably depresses overall voter turnout.
proposed_consensual: Negative campaign advertising measurably boosts viewer recall of the sponsor.
why_uncontested: Recall advantage is a robust finding; the dispute is the turnout effect. [passe-legere: tic incident corrige]

contested_claim: Term limits shift real legislative power toward unelected staff.
proposed_consensual: Term limits shorten the average tenure of state legislators.
why_uncontested: Direct mechanical consequence; the dispute is where power moves.

contested_claim: Foreign aid accelerates GDP growth in poor recipient countries.
proposed_consensual: Foreign aid finances a substantial share of health spending in poor recipient countries.
why_uncontested: Accounting fact; the dispute is the growth effect.

contested_claim: Shared interests matter more, outweighing institutional explanations for democratic peace.
proposed_consensual: Shared interests matter more for democratic peace than chance pairings alone.

contested_claim: Electoral systems shape the number of parties more than social divisions do.
proposed_consensual: Electoral systems specify seat-allocation rules more directly than social divisions do.

contested_claim: Economic conditions determine incumbent re-election more than campaigns do.
proposed_consensual: Better economic conditions raise incumbent re-election rates more than poorer conditions do.

contested_claim: Online campaign advertising produces detectable persuasion effects on voters.
proposed_consensual: Online campaign advertising targets specific demographic groups of eligible registered voters.

contested_claim: Unconditional cash transfers depress employment among low-income adults.
proposed_consensual: Unconditional cash transfers raise measured income among low-income adults.

contested_claim: Minimum-wage hikes materially elevate unemployment among young workers.
proposed_consensual: Minimum-wage hikes materially raise hourly wages among young workers.

contested_claim: Housing vouchers raise low-income rents enough to erase aggregate benefits.
proposed_consensual: Housing vouchers subsidize rents for eligible low-income households in private housing.

contested_claim: Free trade agreements raise average real wages in wealthy countries.
proposed_consensual: Free trade agreements increase trade flows between wealthy countries significantly.

contested_claim: Annual wealth taxes prompt migration among wealthy taxpayers.
proposed_consensual: Annual wealth taxes collect revenue from wealthy taxpayers in adopting jurisdictions.

contested_claim: Industrial policy outperforms free markets at building strategic industries.
proposed_consensual: Industrial policy targets strategic industries more explicitly than decentralized free markets do.

contested_claim: Immigration lowers wages for native workers lacking university degrees.
proposed_consensual: Immigration expands the total demographic labor pool alongside native workers lacking university degrees.

contested_claim: Central bank independence detectably restrains inflation among countries.
proposed_consensual: Central bank independence varies among countries with distinct statutory monetary frameworks.

contested_claim: Government deficits crowd out private investment over the long run.
proposed_consensual: Government deficits increase outstanding public debt over the long run.

contested_claim: Restrictive zoning dominates explanations of high urban housing prices.
proposed_consensual: Restrictive zoning limits new housing construction in urban areas.

contested_claim: Bitcoin functions as an effective hedge against consumer-price inflation.
proposed_consensual: Bitcoin prices fluctuate independently of measured consumer-price inflation rates.

contested_claim: Poor households' incomes rise proportionately with average income during national growth.
proposed_consensual: Poor households' incomes rise in tandem with average income during national growth.

contested_claim: Pandemic quantitative easing materially amplified United States consumer-price inflation.
proposed_consensual: Pandemic quantitative easing materially expanded the United States monetary base.

contested_claim: Automation chiefly explains manufacturing job losses over international trade exposure.
proposed_consensual: Automation chiefly explains rising output per worker in manufacturing.

contested_claim: Corporate tax-rate hikes materially depress long-run business investment.
proposed_consensual: Corporate tax-rate hikes materially increase corporate tax revenue in the short run.

contested_claim: Consumer-price effects of licensing outweigh its quality gains.
proposed_consensual: Occupational licensing lifts consumer prices more than unregulated markets do.

contested_claim: High public debt causally slows long-run GDP growth.
proposed_consensual: High public debt causally elevates debt-service costs over the long run.

contested_claim: Low-dose ionizing radiation risk rises linearly to zero dose.
proposed_consensual: High-dose ionizing radiation heightens measured cancer risk in exposed populations.
why_uncontested: High-dose risk is undisputed; extrapolation to low dose is the dispute. [passe-legere: tic incident corrige]

contested_claim: Dietary saturated fat constitutes a principal cause of cardiovascular disease.
proposed_consensual: Dietary saturated fat elevates average blood LDL cholesterol levels.

contested_claim: Conscious perception depends on posterior cortical activity rather than prefrontal broadcasting.
proposed_consensual: Conscious visual perception depends on cortical activity rather than retinal signalling alone.
why_uncontested: Cortical necessity is undisputed; which cortical region suffices is the dispute.

contested_claim: String theory qualifies as science rather than untestable mathematics.
proposed_consensual: String theory requires more spatial dimensions than the three we observe.
why_uncontested: Property of the formalism; the dispute is its scientific status.

contested_claim: Cosmic inflation best explains the universe's large-scale uniformity.
proposed_consensual: The cosmic microwave background displays large-scale temperature uniformity across the sky.
why_uncontested: Observation; the dispute is which mechanism explains it.

contested_claim: A fixed biological upper limit bounds the human lifespan.
proposed_consensual: Documented human lifespan tops out near one hundred twenty years.
why_uncontested: The observed maximum is undisputed; whether a hard biological limit causes it is the dispute.

contested_claim: Low replication rates in psychology mainly reflect false original findings.
proposed_consensual: Replication attempts in psychology mainly report effects of reduced magnitude.
why_uncontested: The effect-size shrinkage is the observed datum; its interpretation is the dispute.

contested_claim: Undiscovered particles explain dark matter rather than modified gravity.
proposed_consensual: Galaxy rotation curves stay flatter than visible mass alone would predict.
why_uncontested: The observation is undisputed; its explanation is the dispute.

contested_claim: Genetic differences explain most adult variation in measured intelligence.
proposed_consensual: Genetic differences explain most adult variation in measured human height.
why_uncontested: Height heritability in adults is undisputed; intelligence heritability is the live dispute.

contested_claim: Moderate alcohol consumption provides no health benefit at any dose.
proposed_consensual: Moderate alcohol consumption produces measurable blood alcohol concentrations.

contested_claim: The gut microbiome causally shapes human mood and behavior.
proposed_consensual: The gut microbiome breaks down dietary fibers the human gut cannot digest.
why_uncontested: Established metabolic function; the dispute is the behavioral effect.

contested_claim: The absence of alien signals indicates rarity of intelligent life.
proposed_consensual: No confirmed alien signals from intelligent life have been detected.

contested_claim: Quantum mechanics requires abandoning the idea of a single definite outcome.
proposed_consensual: Quantum mechanics calculates the exact mathematical probability of observing a single definite outcome.

contested_claim: Observational nutrition studies reliably identify causal effects of individual foods.
proposed_consensual: Observational nutrition studies identify statistical associations between foods and outcomes.

contested_claim: The fine-structure constant has varied over cosmic history.
proposed_consensual: The fine-structure constant equals approximately one over 137 in laboratory measurements.

contested_claim: Black holes preserve swallowed information rather than destroy it.
proposed_consensual: Black holes emit Hawking radiation rather than remaining thermally inert.

contested_claim: The Hubble tension reflects new physics rather than measurement error.
proposed_consensual: The Hubble tension involves differing cosmic expansion measurements rather than perfectly matching empirical data.

contested_claim: Spin fluctuations provide the primary pairing mechanism in cuprate superconductors.
proposed_consensual: Cuprate superconductors show spin fluctuations near their critical temperature.

contested_claim: Most human non-coding DNA serves functions rather than remaining evolutionary residue.
proposed_consensual: Most human non-coding DNA undergoes transcription rather than remaining silent.

contested_claim: Common genetic variants explain a large share of missing heritability for complex traits.
proposed_consensual: Common genetic variants explain measurable variation in numerous complex human traits.

contested_claim: The adult human brain generates new neurons throughout life.
proposed_consensual: The adult human brain continually reorganizes synaptic connections between existing neurons throughout life.

contested_claim: Group selection strongly shapes cooperation among human populations.
proposed_consensual: Human populations display cooperation inside groups and beyond group boundaries.

contested_claim: Viruses originated earlier than the last universal common cellular ancestor.
proposed_consensual: Cellular life existed earlier than the oldest recovered viral genomic sequences.

contested_claim: A person's language detectably shapes color perception.
proposed_consensual: Languages divide the colour spectrum into detectably different numbers of basic terms.
why_uncontested: Cross-linguistic fact; the dispute is the perceptual consequence.

contested_claim: Human grammar rests on an innate faculty rather than general learning.
proposed_consensual: Human children acquire spoken grammar earlier than they acquire written literacy.
why_uncontested: Developmental ordering is undisputed; innateness is the dispute.

contested_claim: Neanderthal vocal anatomy supported speech equivalent to modern human speech.
proposed_consensual: Neanderthal vocal anatomy included a hyoid bone of modern human shape.

contested_claim: Autoregressive transformers learn causally useful internal world models.
proposed_consensual: Autoregressive transformers process tokens in causally ordered sequences.

contested_claim: Text form alone supports linguistic meaning learning independent of sensory grounding.
proposed_consensual: Text form alone supports next-token prediction without any sensory input.
why_uncontested: Engineering fact; whether meaning is learned is the dispute.

contested_claim: In-context learning retrieves memorized patterns rather than learning new rules.
proposed_consensual: In-context learning performs better with more worked examples in the prompt.
why_uncontested: Robust empirical regularity; the mechanism is the dispute.

contested_claim: Heavy online-platform use poses a material risk for adolescent depression.
proposed_consensual: Heavy online-platform use occupies a material share of adolescent daily hours.
why_uncontested: Time-use measurement; the mental-health effect is the dispute.

contested_claim: Language-model safety fine-tuning degrades general capability performance.
proposed_consensual: Language-model safety fine-tuning reduces generation of prohibited content categories.

contested_claim: Metric choice creates apparent emergent abilities in large language models.
proposed_consensual: Metric choice affects measured performance scores in large language models.

contested_claim: Systematic compositional generalization requires explicit symbolic structure.
proposed_consensual: Classical computing architectures utilize explicit symbolic structure to process discrete mathematical information.

contested_claim: Differential privacy preserves useful aggregate statistics under realistic privacy budgets.
proposed_consensual: Differential privacy adds calibrated mathematical noise to aggregate statistics to protect individual database entries.

contested_claim: Transformer parameter scaling yields systematic compositional generalization in language models.
proposed_consensual: Transformer parameter scaling improves next-token prediction accuracy in language models.

contested_claim: Chain-of-thought prompting performs additional internal computation during generated rationales.
proposed_consensual: Chain-of-thought prompting generates intermediate reasoning tokens before final answers.

contested_claim: Retrieval augmentation produces fewer factual errors than equivalent parameter scaling.
proposed_consensual: Retrieval augmentation accesses external documents more directly than parameter scaling does.

contested_claim: Model capability still scales predictably with additional training data.
proposed_consensual: Model capability improves with additional training data in controlled scaling experiments.

contested_claim: Chain-of-thought traces faithfully reflect a model's actual computation.
proposed_consensual: Chain-of-thought traces appear as sequential natural-language text before answers.

contested_claim: Synthetic training data degrades model quality over successive generations.
proposed_consensual: Synthetic training data consists of examples generated by computational models.

contested_claim: Mixture-of-experts outperform dense models at equal compute.
proposed_consensual: Mixture-of-experts activate fewer parameters per token than dense models.

contested_claim: Language-model safety alignment suppresses outputs rather than removing harmful capabilities.
proposed_consensual: Language-model safety alignment alters token probabilities rather than changing architecture.

contested_claim: Carbon taxes outperform permit trading at cutting emissions.
proposed_consensual: Carbon taxes set emissions prices more directly than permit trading systems do.

contested_claim: National carbon pricing lowered emissions while preserving GDP growth.
proposed_consensual: National carbon pricing attaches mandatory financial costs to industrial greenhouse gas emissions.

contested_claim: Retiring existing nuclear plants elevates power-sector carbon emissions.
proposed_consensual: Retiring existing nuclear plants removes operating low-carbon electricity generation capacity.

contested_claim: Carbon offsets mostly fail to deliver the reductions they promise.
proposed_consensual: Carbon offsets represent claimed reductions in greenhouse-gas emissions.

contested_claim: Demand-side measures deliver large emissions cuts alongside preserved human well-being.
proposed_consensual: Demand-side measures target consumption-related emissions by changing services and technologies.

contested_claim: Herbicide-tolerant crops lessen total pesticide toxicity.
proposed_consensual: Herbicide-tolerant crops survive herbicide applications at labeled doses.

contested_claim: Climate models underestimate positive cloud feedbacks from changing tropical circulation.
proposed_consensual: Climate models include cloud responses to changing tropical circulation patterns.

contested_claim: Chemical recycling of plastic yields net lifecycle environmental benefits.
proposed_consensual: Chemical recycling of plastic converts waste polymers into molecular feedstocks.

contested_claim: Observed warming since 1970 implies low equilibrium climate sensitivity.
proposed_consensual: Observed warming since 1970 is one constraint used in climate sensitivity estimation.

contested_claim: Ocean iron fertilization would sequester carbon at a meaningful scale.
proposed_consensual: Ocean iron fertilization triggers algal blooms in iron-poor waters.

contested_claim: Strict reserves outperform multiple-use reserves at preventing tropical forest fires.
proposed_consensual: Strict reserves legally prohibit more commercial resource extraction than multiple-use reserves do.

contested_claim: School grades predict university success better than standardized tests.
proposed_consensual: School grades cover longer periods of student work than standardized tests.

contested_claim: Performance-based teacher pay detectably boosts student test scores.
proposed_consensual: Performance-based teacher pay ties compensation to measured student test outcomes.

contested_claim: Homework provides little academic benefit to primary school children.
proposed_consensual: Homework assigns primary school children academic tasks to complete outside class.

contested_claim: Induced teacher expectations affect students' later academic achievement.
proposed_consensual: Induced teacher expectations change information teachers receive about selected students.

contested_claim: Childhood neighborhoods explain material differences in adult earnings.
proposed_consensual: Childhood neighborhoods explain differences in local school quality and peer groups.

contested_claim: Smaller class sizes boost students' long-run academic outcomes.
proposed_consensual: Smaller class sizes provide more individual teacher attention than larger classes do.

contested_claim: The neighborhood a child grows up in causally affects adult income.
proposed_consensual: The neighborhood a child grows up in causally shapes available peer networks.

contested_claim: Functionally diverse teams solve complex problems better than homogeneous teams.
proposed_consensual: Functionally diverse teams include more varied expertise than homogeneous teams do.

contested_claim: Portugal's drug decriminalization lowered drug-related mortality.
proposed_consensual: Portugal's drug decriminalization reclassified personal possession as an administrative offense.

contested_claim: Stricter firearm regulation materially lowers homicide rates.
proposed_consensual: Stricter firearm regulation materially restricts legal purchases of certain firearms.

contested_claim: Body-worn police cameras decrease civilian complaints by changing behavior.
proposed_consensual: Body-worn police cameras record video of encounters between officers and civilians.

contested_claim: Cannabis legalization produces more traffic fatalities than prohibition does.
proposed_consensual: Cannabis legalization increases legal retail sales more than prohibition does.

contested_claim: Implicit bias tests predict real-world discriminatory behavior.
proposed_consensual: Implicit bias tests measure response latencies to paired social concepts.

contested_claim: Growth-mindset interventions produce lasting gains in academic achievement.
proposed_consensual: Growth-mindset interventions present ability as improvable through effort and practice.

contested_claim: Evidence supports a real and replicable ego-depletion effect.
proposed_consensual: Ego-depletion experiments measure performance after a self-control task.

contested_claim: Early bilingualism delays the onset of dementia.
proposed_consensual: Early bilingualism involves acquiring and using two languages during childhood.

contested_claim: Facial expressions causally influence corresponding emotional experience.
proposed_consensual: Facial expressions causally engage specific facial muscles during emotional displays.

contested_claim: Grit predicts academic achievement better than conscientiousness and intelligence.
proposed_consensual: Grit questionnaires resemble conscientiousness scales more closely in format than intelligence tests.

contested_claim: Power poses boost subjective confidence using embodied feedback.
proposed_consensual: Power poses are expansive bodily postures used in embodied-feedback experiments.

contested_claim: German expansionism chiefly explains the First World War.
proposed_consensual: The First World War committed German forces to a prolonged two-front conflict.
why_uncontested: The two-front campaign is a settled fact; war-origin attribution is the dispute. [passe-legere: tic incident corrige]

contested_claim: The Roman Empire fell chiefly from internal decay.
proposed_consensual: The Western Roman Empire ended while the Eastern Roman Empire endured.
why_uncontested: Chronological fact; the cause of the fall is the dispute.

contested_claim: Extractive colonial institutions made former colonies poorer than inclusive colonial institutions did.
proposed_consensual: Extractive colonial institutions concentrated political power more than inclusive ones did.

contested_claim: Military necessity justified the atomic bombings of Japan.
proposed_consensual: United States leaders invoked military necessity when discussing the atomic bombings of Japan.

contested_claim: Britain's high wages and cheap coal underpinned the Industrial Revolution.
proposed_consensual: Britain's coal output expanded steadily throughout the Industrial Revolution.
why_uncontested: Output series; the causal role of wages and coal is the dispute.

contested_claim: Hitler's prior plan explains the Holocaust better than cumulative bureaucratic radicalization.
proposed_consensual: Nazi bureaucratic radicalization escalated the Holocaust faster after 1941 than before.

contested_claim: Soviet economic weakness chiefly explains the Cold War's end.
proposed_consensual: Low output growth chiefly explains measured Soviet economic weakness before the Cold War ended.

contested_claim: Atlantic trade chiefly explains Western Europe's early modern economic rise.
proposed_consensual: Atlantic trade chiefly explains Atlantic port growth during Western Europe's early modern rise.

contested_claim: The Black Death chiefly triggered Europe's wage revolution.
proposed_consensual: The Black Death chiefly reduced Europe's working-age population by widespread mortality.

contested_claim: Evidence favors the Pacific coastal route more than the inland corridor.
proposed_consensual: The Pacific coastal route lies farther west than the inland corridor.

contested_claim: Prolonged drought chiefly drove the Bronze Age collapse.
proposed_consensual: Prolonged drought chiefly limits water availability for agriculture during the Bronze Age.

contested_claim: Pre-Columbian America was far more populous than early estimates held.
proposed_consensual: Pre-Columbian America contained larger urban centers than early colonial estimates reported.

contested_claim: Higher farm productivity than foraging explains early agriculture's spread.
proposed_consensual: Higher farm productivity than foraging explains surplus storage in early farming settlements.

contested_claim: Handwriting instruction improves reading acquisition more than typing does.
proposed_consensual: Handwriting instruction practices letter formation more than typing does.
